definition: Christopher Arthur Lattner (born 1978) is an American software engineer and creator of the compiler and related toolchain system LLVM, Clang, the MLIR infrastructure, and the programming languages Swift and Mojo.
details: Created LLVM and MLIR (Multi-Level Intermediate Representation for AI compilers) and founded Modular to unify AI infrastructure with the Mojo language. After gaining a PhD in computer science, Lattner worked at Apple for 12 years, eventually leading the Apple Developer Tools team. Between 2017 and 2022, he worked in various positions for Tesla, Google, and SiFive. He is currently co-founder and CEO of Modular AI, a company building an artificial intelligence developer platform.
